scenes.say: In early Formula E, drivers jumped out of their car mid-race and climbed into a second one.
It started on a napkin: in Paris, March twenty eleven, Jean Todt and Alejandro Agag sketched the series.
First race: Beijing, September twenty fourteen. Prost and Heidfeld crash at the last corner, di Grassi wins.
One battery couldn't last a race, so drivers swapped cars halfway. That went on for four seasons.
Gen2 went the full distance on one battery. Gen3 added a front motor and dropped rear hydraulic brakes.
Gen4 is testing now, Mortara lapped in one twenty-four. It races first in Mexico City on January sixteenth.
The Formula E calendar is on LapRadar.

title: How Formula E was born: a napkin, Beijing and the mid-race car swap
